title: RIFTRunRecord
description: JSON Schema for the artifact produced by one complete RIFTEndToEndRunner.run() call. A run is valid for Gate 3.5E iff live_telemetry_used=true AND synthetic_substitution=false.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run (UUID v4).

started_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the run began (time.time()).

pipeline_stages.description: Ordered list of PipelineStageRecord objects, one per pipeline stage transition. MUST contain exactly 17 entries for a complete run.

attribution.description: Attributed root-cause service ID, or null if RIFT abstains or no attribution is made.

attribution_confidence.description: Confidence level of the attribution. DEFINITIVE requires R1-R4. CANDIDATE requires R1-R3. NONE means RIFT abstains.

live_telemetry_used.description: True iff all metric data was sourced from a live PrometheusClient endpoint. MUST be true for Gate 3.5E validity. A run sourced from MockTelemetry sets this to false.

synthetic_substitution.description: True iff any synthetic or mock metric data was substituted at any stage. MUST be false for Gate 3.5E validity. Even a single MockTelemetry substitution invalidates the run for evaluation purposes.

intervention_records.description: Serialised summaries of NetworkInterventionRecord objects produced at stage DO_X.

ebd_results.description: Serialised summaries of EBDResult objects produced at stage EBD.

total_duration_s.description: Wall-clock duration of the entire run in seconds.

provenance.description: Maps each stage name to its provenance descriptor. A researcher must be able to trace every variable in the final attribution back to a specific Prometheus scrape, Jaeger span, or tc measurement by following provenance[stage_name].upstream chains to provenance['OBSERVE'].telemetry_ref.

notes.description: Free-form annotation. Must include synthetic_substitution reason if synthetic_substitution=true.

PipelineStageRecord.title: PipelineStageRecord
PipelineStageRecord.description: Record of one stage execution in the RIFT 17-stage pipeline. Produced for every stage regardless of success or failure.

stage.description: Stage identifier matching the e2e_pipeline_spec.json stage_name.

started_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this stage began.

completed_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this stage completed.

duration_s.description: Stage duration in seconds (completed_at - started_at). Used for Gate 3.5M latency measurement.

output_summary.description: Stage-specific key-value summary of the stage output. Schema varies per stage.

provenance.description: Human-readable description of what data source or upstream stage fed this stage. Must link back to telemetry_ref in the run's provenance map.

notes.description: Free-form annotation for this stage (warnings, fallbacks, errors).

InterventionRecordSummary.title: InterventionRecordSummary
InterventionRecordSummary.description: Serialised summary of a NetworkInterventionRecord produced at stage DO_X.

source_service.description: Service on which the intervention was applied.

dry_run.description: True if tc commands were only logged, not executed.

EBDResultSummary.title: EBDResultSummary
EBDResultSummary.description: Serialised summary of an EBDResult produced at stage EBD.

service_id.description: Service ID of the EBD candidate.

t_star.description: Timestamp of first divergence (unix seconds or window-relative seconds).

r1_pass.description: Observed behavioral deviation: delta_ik(t) > theta_detect for >= 2*delta_t.

r2_pass.description: Temporal precedence: t* < t_j for all other diverging services.

r3_pass.description: Causal relevance: causal path exists in G_T from this service to a downstream diverging service.

r4_pass.description: Intervention evidence: CID(V_i -> V_j, t*) > theta_cid confirmed by do(X).

boundary_limited.description: True if the true root cause may lie outside the k<=15 subgraph boundary.

anomaly_score.description: Maximum z-score observed for this service in the incident window.

ProvenanceEntry.title: ProvenanceEntry
ProvenanceEntry.description: Links one pipeline stage to its data source and upstream stage. A researcher must be able to trace any variable in the final attribution to raw telemetry by following upstream chains to OBSERVE.telemetry_ref.

source.description: Python module and function that produced this stage's output (e.g. 'cid/cid.py compute_cid()').

upstream.description: Name of the upstream stage(s) that fed this stage, or null for OBSERVE (root stage).

telemetry_ref.description: Reference to the raw telemetry source (e.g. 'PrometheusClient:http://prometheus:9090' or 'MockTelemetry:seed=42'). This is the terminal node in the provenance chain.
